name: Jordan Guzman
office: City of San Gabriel, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jordan Guzman is a professional musician and educator. At a May 2026 city council meeting, he raised concerns about the length of the Athens Services agreement and new rates for a third recycling bin. His campaign website lists priorities of public safety, infrastructure improvements, and community-building programs.
